title: `teploy redeploy [--app X --host S] --json`: the machine result of a successful redeploy (rev 14, token redeploy-v1)

home.description: Which config the redeploy deployed from.

release.description: Release id now current (the redeployed release; same id for same-version redeploys).

image.description: Image the release runs (the recorded image, digest-pinned when the tag had moved).

ok.description: Always true on this document; failures and refusals (static apps, unrecorded releases) use the error envelope.
